mysticism.skill.light_domination.descrip:
Light arrows: 20 damage each, aimed up to 30 blocks away.
*Press*: 10 arrows (15 mastered).
*Toggle*: light abilities ×3; mastery weakens enemy light resistance.
mysticism.skill.light_manipulation.descr:
A light beam: 20 damage, reaches 30 blocks.
*Hold*: keep firing.
*Toggle*: light abilities ×1.5.
mysticism.skill.mithril_strength.descrip:
Strengthen III for 60s (IV for 120s mastered). 10,000 magicule.
*Press*: buff yourself.
*Toggle* (mastered): sustain Strengthen III; drains magicule.
mysticism.skill.profaned_prominence.desc:
Melts ground and breathes fire.
*Toggle*: fire ×1.5; hits burn for 15s (30s mastered).
[Fire Breath] *hold*: 16 damage (32 mastered).
[Providence] *press*: lava within 8 blocks, down 16; fails if water is there. 1,000 magicule.
tensura.skill.black_flame.description:
Black flames and explosive shots.
*Toggle*: hits inflict Black Burn for 10s.
[Flame Breath] *hold*: 9 fire + 1 magic damage (18 + 2 mastered).
[Fireball] *press*: 45 fire + 5 magic.
[Hell Flare] *press*: 270 + 30, radius 15.
[Limited Hell Flare] *press*: 720 + 80, radius 2.5. Both flares cost 2,000 magicule.
tensura.skill.black_lightning.descriptio:
Lightning + magic damage; aim up to 50 blocks.
*Press* for bolts:
[Default Power]: 45 + 5 damage, radius 8.
[Decreased Power]: 22.5 + 2.5, radius 5.
[Increased Power]: 135 + 15, radius 12.
[Blast] *hold*: 22.5 + 2.5 beam, range 30.
[Death Storm] *press*: bolts and tornadoes within 30; 5,000 magicule. Again to stop.
tensura.skill.body_double.description:
A fighting clone using 10% of your maximum magicule.
[Clone Creation] *press*: summon.
[Clone Control] *press* at your clone within 50: swap bodies; leaves your original still and gives Fragility II and Energy Blockade V. Stay within 50 of your original or take damage.
*Sneak+press* in Control: dismiss a moving clone.
tensura.skill.earth_domination.descripti:
Earth abilities ×3 while toggled.
[Earth Wall] *press*: raise a 4-high wall for 60s.
[Blocks Break] *press*: break earth blocks within 5 blocks.
[Earth Pit] *press*: dig beneath you, radius 2, depth 5.
*Toggle*: boost on/off.
tensura.skill.flame_domination.descripti:
Fire abilities ×3 while toggled. Slotted hits burn for 10s (20s mastered).
*Hold*: fire breath, 8 damage (20 mastered).
*Toggle*: boost on/off; mastery weakens enemy fire resistance.
tensura.skill.gravity_domination.descrip:
Gravity abilities and mace smash damage ×3 while toggled.
*Press*: flight on/off; blocked by Magic Interference. 1,000 magicule.
*Toggle*: boost on/off; mastery weakens enemy gravity resistance.
tensura.skill.hero_haki.description:
Fear for 10s on foes under half your EP; larger EP gaps cause stronger Fear.
*Hold*: sustain the aura, 15 blocks; slows you while held.
*Scroll* (mastered): Power Scale.
tensura.skill.law_manipulation.descripti:
Cleanses abnormalities and takes over magic.
[Abnormality Cleanse] *press*: self; *sneak+press*: target within 20. Removes Magic Interference too.
[Takeover] *press*: steal a spell shot, break a casting circle or close a portal within 30.
*Toggle*: at 1 million EP, mastered magic/battlewill bypasses resistance.
tensura.skill.lightning_domination.descr:
Lightning strike: 30 damage, 5-block radius. Requires a thunderstorm.
*Press*: aim up to 30 blocks away.
*Toggle*: lightning ×3; mastery weakens enemy lightning resistance.
tensura.skill.lightning_manipulation.des:
Lightning strike: 15 damage, 3-block radius. Requires a thunderstorm.
*Press*: aim up to 30 blocks away.
*Toggle*: lightning abilities ×1.5.
tensura.skill.magic_aura.description:
Hits add 50% attack damage as magic for 300s; does not work with slotted weapons.
*Press*: on/off.
[Default]: magic. Mastered: [Holy], [Earth], [Fire], [Space], [Water], [Wind] choose damage type. Elemental modes cost 1,000 magicule.
tensura.skill.magic_darkness_transform.d:
Darkness damage ×1.2; hits inflict Darkness for 10s. 10,000 magicule.
*Press*: form for 180s (360s mastered); again to end.
After: Weakness II, Fragility II and Paralysis I for 600s; cooldown 600s.
{P}: learns darkness spirit spells through Greater tier.
tensura.skill.magic_earth_transform.desc:
Earth damage ×1.2; hits inflict Burden I for 10s. 10,000 magicule.
*Press*: form for 180s (360s mastered); again to end.
After: Weakness II, Fragility II and Paralysis I for 600s; cooldown 600s.
{P}: learns earth spirit spells through Greater tier.

*Press*: form for 180s (360s mastered); again to end.
After: Weakness II, Fragility II and Paralysis I for 600s; cooldown 600s.
{P}: learns flame spirit spells through Greater tier.
tensura.skill.magic_light_transform.desc:
Light damage ×1.2; hits inflict Nausea for 10s. 10,000 magicule.
*Press*: form for 180s (360s mastered); again to end.
After: Weakness II, Fragility II and Paralysis I for 600s; cooldown 600s.
{P}: learns light spirit spells through Greater tier.
tensura.skill.magic_space_transform.desc:
Spatial damage ×1.2. 10,000 magicule.
*Press*: form for 180s (360s mastered); again to end.
After: Weakness II, Fragility II and Paralysis I for 600s; cooldown 600s.
{P}: learns space spirit spells through Greater tier.
tensura.skill.magic_water_transform.desc:
Water damage ×1.2; hits inflict Fatal Poison I for 10s. 10,000 magicule.
*Press*: form for 180s (360s mastered); again to end.
After: Weakness II, Fragility II and Paralysis I for 600s; cooldown 600s.
{P}: learns water spirit spells through Greater tier.
tensura.skill.magic_wind_transform.descr:
Wind damage ×1.2; hits inflict Paralysis I for 10s. 10,000 magicule.
*Press*: form for 180s (360s mastered); again to end.
After: Weakness II, Fragility II and Paralysis I for 600s; cooldown 600s.
{P}: learns wind spirit spells through Greater tier.
tensura.skill.multilayer_barrier.descrip:
Blocks up to ×1.5 your max HP per hit; 5 magicule per damage stopped. Bigger hits break it.
*Press*: self on/off.
*Sneak+press* at an ally within 5: on/off, blocks ×0.75 their max HP per hit.
tensura.skill.sacred_haki.description:
Fears foes under half your EP; heals allies 60 HP every 5s and clears harmful effects.
[Magicule Release] *hold*: aura, 15 blocks.
[Magicule Coat] *press*: Haki Coat for 120s; again to end.
*Scroll* in Release (mastered): Power Scale.
